<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Cracked Mountain](/Feats.aspx?ID=4181) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 111

**Archetype** [Stalwart Defender](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=205)

**Frequency**
once per hour

**Prerequisites**
[Stalwart Defender Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4172)

**Trigger**
You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

**Requirements**
You are in Tenacious Stance.

</column>

---

You fight on, staying on your feet and lashing out at a foe. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your [wounded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=42) condition increases by 1. Make a melee Strike at an enemy within reach. You immediately end your Tenacious Stance.
name: Cracked Mountain
